newsitem.title: USA: A.M. Best puts Great-West,London Life under review.
newsitem.headline: A.M. Best puts Great-West,London Life under review.

text.p: A.M. Best Co said Tuesday it placed the A++ (superior) ratings of Great-West Lifeco's Great West Life Assurance Co and London Life Insurance Co under review, following Great-West's announcement to buy London's parent London Insurance Group Inc

The rating agency said the ratings will remain under review pending further discussions with senior management regarding expense savings and synergies to be realized from the combined organizations, and financing arrangements and the determination of the final price of the transaction.

A.M. Best said the rating action affects the following subsidiary companies: Great-West Life & Annuity Insurance Co of Denver (rated A++), First Great-West Life & Annuity Insurance Co of Albany, N.Y., (A++), and London Life Reinsurance Co of Blue Bell, Pa. (A+).

The rating agency said Great-West's acquisition will create a market leader in Canada by asset size and revenues, with a leadership position in individual life and disability insurance and in the small and large group life and health market.

The combined organizations also would hold the largest share of the segregated funds market, A.M. Best said. It added the companies may develop substantial cost savings and synergies as they eliminate duplication and enhance the product portfolio available to the various distribution channels.
